summary: Frontend-only testing of Quantum Mind OS integration (iter17). All requested features verified end-to-end via Playwright: QUANTUM tab renders, SVG brain seeds & dedupes nodes, reset/wipe works, terminal slash commands /quantum, /qstatus, /qwipe behave per spec, help text updated, auto-tab-switch works, and regression on EVOLUTION tab passed.
critical_code_review_comments: QuantumScreen.jsx uses a 250ms setInterval ticker just to animate <2s firing pulses — fine for this build, but consider stopping the interval when no node has activity<2s to save CPU on idle.
quantumMindOS.js: QuantumState.collapse() may return undefined if states is empty (no fallback after the for-loop). Not currently triggered (always 3 weighted states) but worth a 1-line guard.
MemoryLattice.recall(missing key) returns [] (array) in one branch and {value,linked} (object) otherwise — inconsistent return shape. Consider always returning the object form with nulls.
ChatConsole.jsx is now ~1430 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting the command-handler switch into a separate /lib/commands.js module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quantum brain is an in-memory singleton (quantumOS) shared between QuantumScreen and ChatConsole — does NOT persist across page reload by design. /quantum, /qstatus, /qwipe work. Tab strip has 11 tabs; quantum is rightmost — use scroll_into_view_if_needed() before click. data-testids of interest: center-tab-quantum, quantum-screen, quantum-brain, quantum-input, quantum-process-btn, quantum-reset-btn, quantum-result, qnode-<id-prefix>. Note: collapse() is non-deterministic (weighted random) — never assert which superposition layer was selected, only that result is non-empty and superposition has 3 layers.
